item.title: How to watch: World Supercross RD4 – Sweden
item.description: The 2025 FIM World Supercross Championship makes its sole European appearance of the season this weekend as the championship heads to Stockholm for Round 4, the Swedish GP. As the penultimate stop on the calendar, the 3Arena is positioned to play a significant role in shaping both the SX1 and SX2 championship outcomes, as well...

item.title: Live stream: World Supercross RD4 – Sweden
item.description: The penultimate round of the World Supercross series heads to Sweden this weekend. Jason Anderson and Christian Craig are likely to battle things out at the front to win the WSX title. In SX2, Max Anstie has been in superb form and will hope to continue his winning streak. Watch all the action below:

item.title: Free practice results: World Supercross RD4 – Sweden
item.description: In SX1, Joey Savatgy set the early pace in a Quad Lock Honda 1-2 in free practice. Christian Craig was second fastest. Greg Aranda was third fastest with Jordi Tixier fourth and Jason Anderson rounding out the top five. In SX2, Shane McElrath set the pace in free practice over Coty Schock with Cole Thompson...

item.title: First look: Swedish World Supercross GP – ruts!
item.description: Fastest in free practice, Joey Savatgy has released a video of the first on track action, showing just how technical and rutted the circuit is in complete contract to the prevous slick rounds! It’s going to be a challenging night of racing for the riders!

item.title: Qualifying results: World Supercross RD4 – Sweden
item.description: Joey Savatgy set the pace in the SX1 class over his team mate, Christian Craig. Jason Anderson was third fastest over Jordi Tixier with Greg Aranda rounding out the top five. item.title: Video: Max Anstie crashes in the Swedish ruts
item.description: Even SX2 World Supercross points leader, Max Anstie, found the ruts challenging in Sweden during practice as he went down pretty hard in the second session after getting caught up in the gnarly ruts and losing his grip on the bike. Thankfully Max was uninjured and still went second in the session before taking third...

item.description: Race One: It was Michael Hicks who held the early lead and was looking good but with two laps to go Shane McElrath made a move and Max Anstie followed him through. item.title: SX1 race results: World Supercross RD4 – Sweden – Anderson wins
item.description: Race One: Jason Anderson held the early lead but Joey Savatgy was able to make a move to get into the lead and take the win in very soft and gnarly conditions.
